segments.text: The rope snaps on a floating fishing hut, and the ocean takes the teenager inside.
No engine, no paddle, food for a few days. Land is {125|a hundred and twenty-five} kilometres away.
So he catches fish, and burns the hut's own fence to cook them. For water, he sips the sea through his clothes.
Then, a ship. He waves. It sails past. So do more than {10|ten} others. He says he cried often.
Day {49|forty-nine}. Another one passes, so he grabs his radio and calls for help. This one turns around.
The waves are too high to come alongside. So he jumps in, and the crew haul him aboard, alive. Nineteen years old, thousands of kilometres from home.
